extDescription.message: Group your tabs with the AI of your choice, with preview and undo.

errorPropose.message: The proposal could not be computed.

errorApply.message: The groups could not be created.

errorUndo.message: The organization could not be undone.

popupMoveTab.message: Move the tab to another group

popupRemoveTab.message: Remove from group (the tab stays open and ungrouped)

optionsMinTabs.message: Minimum number of tabs to create a new group

optionsMinTabsHint.message: A single tab can still join a group that already exists.

optionsMinTabsInvalid.message: Enter a whole number greater than or equal to 1.

optionsExcludedDomainsHint.message: Tabs from these domains, and their subdomains, are never suggested or sent to the AI and stay free.

optionsDomainInvalid.message: This does not look like a valid domain.

optionsDomainDuplicate.message: This domain is already in the list.

optionsSitesInvalid.message: Invalid sites: check that each site is written correctly and is in only one category.

optionsSitesTooMany.message: Too many sites: Chrome can't save them. Remove a few.

errorUnexpected.message: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

category_work_description.message: Work tools and pages: company email, calendar, shared documents, project management, CRM, meetings.

category_dev_description.message: Programming and developer tools: code repositories, technical documentation, issues, CI, Stack Overflow, cloud consoles.

category_ai_description.message: Artificial intelligence assistants and services: chats with language models, image generators, AI platforms and news.

category_social_description.message: Social networks and communities: profiles, feeds, messages, forums and discussions.

category_news_description.message: Newspapers, news sites, current-affairs blogs and newsletters.

category_video_description.message: Videos, streaming, films, series, music and podcasts.

category_shopping_description.message: Online stores, product pages, carts, price comparisons and product reviews.

category_travel_description.message: Flights, trains, hotels, accommodation, maps, guides and travel bookings.

category_finance_description.message: Banking, payments, investments, crypto, taxes and bills.

category_study_description.message: Courses, lessons, scientific papers, encyclopedias, dictionaries and study material.

optionsCategoriesHint.message: Categories are the options the AI chooses from. The description explains what belongs in each one; the color is the color of the created group.

optionsNoCategories.message: No categories: the AI can only invent new groups.

categoryNameEmpty.message: The category name cannot be empty.

categoryNameDuplicate.message: A category with this name already exists.

categoryNameTooLong.message: The category name is too long (maximum 40 characters).

categoryDescriptionTooLong.message: The description is too long (maximum 300 characters).

categoryInvalid.message: The category list is not valid.

errorSaveSettings.message: The settings could not be saved.

optionsGeneratorHint.message: The Generator picks among the categories or invents new groups. Gemini Nano runs in the browser, with no keys and no data sent; alternatively you can use an OpenAI-compatible model.

optionsApiKeyHint.message: The key stays on this computer only (it is not synced).

optionsGeneratorDisabled.message: Generator off: only the Classifier decides, or tabs are grouped by site.

optionsGeneratorIncomplete.message: Enter base URL and model to use the Generator.

optionsGeneratorBadUrl.message: The base URL must start with http:// or https://.

warning_rate_limit.message: $PROVIDER$: too many requests, try again shortly.

warning_invalid_request.message: $PROVIDER$ rejected the request (invalid model or parameters).

warning_no_permission.message: $PROVIDER$: network permission missing. Save the provider again in the settings and grant the permission.

warning_needs_download.message: $PROVIDER$ needs to be downloaded: start the download from the settings.

warning_downloading.message: $PROVIDER$ is downloading and will be used when ready.

nanoStatus_available.message: Gemini Nano is available and will be used.

nanoStatus_downloadable.message: Gemini Nano is supported but needs to be downloaded (about 2-4 GB).

nanoStatus_unavailable.message: Gemini Nano is not supported by this browser or computer: tabs will be grouped by site.

optionsClassifierHint.message: A System One classifier (Jev, Kev, Rizzo Flow) assigns each tab to a category or an open group, with a calibrated confidence. It is fast and cheap; uncertain tabs go to the Generator.

optionsClassifierDisabled.message: Classifier disabled: the Generator decides (or grouping by domain).

optionsClassifierModelPlaceholder.message: e.g. jev-latest (optional for Kev and Rizzo Flow)

optionsThresholdHint.message: Tabs with lower confidence are not assigned by the Classifier and go to the Generator.

optionsThresholdInvalid.message: The threshold must be a number between 0 and 1.

optionsProviderInvalid.message: The provider configuration is not valid.

popupSaveToListHint.message: Adds this group to the categories, with a description generated by the AI

panelSiteRemembered.message: Tabs from $SITE$ will always go to $CATEGORY$.

saveToListNoDescription.message: “$NAME$” was added to the categories without a description: complete it in the settings.

saveToListDuplicate.message: A category “$NAME$” already exists: it was not duplicated.

panelPreviewComputing.message: Meanwhile, the by-site proposal: AI is computing…

popupAborted.message: Computation stopped: no proposal. Press “Recompute” to try again.

optionsReadDescriptions.message: Read page descriptions for better accuracy

optionsReadDescriptionsHint.message: Asks for permission to read the sites you visit. Only the page description (meta description) is read, never the content; sleeping tabs, excluded domains, Chrome pages, the Web Store and PDFs are never read. Turning the switch off removes the permission.

optionsReadDescriptionsDenied.message: Permission not granted: only title and URL will be used.

optionsModeDomainHint.message: Tabs from the same site go in the same group. Instant, no setup, no data leaves your computer.

optionsModeAiHint.message: AI picks from your categories or invents new ones. If no provider answers, tabs are grouped by site.

optionsModeDomainNote.message: Grouping by site: categories and AI providers are not used. Choose "By topic, with AI" to set them up.

panelStale.message: Your tabs changed after this proposal.

panelModeSiteSummary.message: Tabs from the same site go together. No data is sent.

panelNoProvider.message: No AI provider set up: tabs are grouped by site.

panelFreeHint.message: These stay out of groups. You can add them to a group.

onboardingWelcomeText.message: autoGroup suggests groups for the ungrouped tabs in your window. You see a preview first and can change it: no tab moves until you press “Apply”, and “Undo” puts everything back.

onboardingWelcomeShortcut.message: To open it, click the extension icon or press $SHORTCUT$.

onboardingWelcomeNoShortcut.message: To open it, click the extension icon. You can assign it a shortcut at chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

onboardingWelcomeSetup.message: In a couple of minutes you'll choose how to group. You can change everything later in the settings.

onboardingModeTitle.message: How do you want to group?

onboardingModeText.message: “By site” works right away. “With AI” splits tabs by topic: in the next steps you choose who does the work. You can switch at any time, from the panel too.

onboardingGeneratorText.message: The Generator reads the title and address of your tabs, puts them in your categories and makes up new groups when needed. You have three options:

onboardingGeneratorNanoText.message: Built into Chrome: free, no keys, no data leaves your computer. It is downloaded once, if your computer supports it.

onboardingGeneratorLocalText.message: Ollama, LM Studio or Unsloth Studio on your computer: private, but you need an installed model.

onboardingGeneratorCloudText.message: OpenRouter or another OpenAI-compatible service: the most capable, but it needs an API key and titles and addresses are sent to the service.

onboardingGeneratorDefault.message: Gemini Nano is already selected: if that suits you, press “Next”. Otherwise choose below and press “Save”.

onboardingClassifierText.message: A System One classifier (Jev, Kev, Rizzo Flow) puts each tab in one of your categories in a few tenths of a second; uncertain tabs go to the Generator. If you don't have one, press “Next”: you can add it later in the settings.

onboardingDoneDomain.message: Tabs from the same site will go into the same group. No data leaves your computer.

onboardingDonePlan.message: This is how the proposal will be made:

onboardingDoneFallback.message: If a level is off or doesn't answer, the next one takes over, with a notice in the panel: you always get a proposal.

onboardingDonePrivacy.message: The AI only receives the title and address of your tabs (without parameters), never tabs from excluded domains. Categories, excluded domains and page descriptions can be changed in the settings.

optionsReadDescriptionsProviderLost.message: Descriptions are off, but a provider lost access to its server: save it again in its section.
